metadata.title: A note on coupled Dirac-harmonic maps
metadata.abstract: We construct coupled Dirac-harmonic maps from manifolds of the form $S^1\times M$ where $M$ is a spin manifold equipped with a pair of harmonic spinors satisfying a norm condition. This method produces coupled Dirac-harmonic maps from closed manifolds.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 乘积 spin source 的 coupled Dirac 解
analysis.workSummary: 在 S¹×M 上借 harmonic spinor pair 与范数条件构造 Dirac–harmonic map，map component 非 harmonic，给 genuine coupling 的新例子。
analysis.breakthrough: 以 spinor 配对提供真正耦合解的构造。
analysis.limitations: 存在性依赖 spinor pair 的指定范数约束，不能推广到任意乘积 spin manifold。
